# tool (.github/scripts/shardtests.go): one line per package, relative to the
# module, with the columns of the profiles it is run with. They are read from
# the log of run 39766273971 (22 October), the whole test step of each leg, so
# they include the slowdown of packages sharing four cores.

# DEFAULT_WEIGHT, a package whose weight is out of date makes its shard slower
# or faster, and neither can make a test run twice or not at all: that is
# decided by the names of the packages and the tests alone.
